predictedBugs: Odd contact counts could expose the grouped surface divider background as a blank desktop cell; fixed with an explicit last-odd-item span rule.
Three 44px quick actions could compress contact identity at 375px; fixed by moving actions to a second grid row below the content on small screens.
Running next build while a dev server owns the same .next directory can leave stale client chunks; final visual evidence was captured from an isolated clean server and the build was rerun without it.
edgeCases: Contacts with phone only, email only, or all three quick actions retain a readable layout and labeled actions.
Light and dark themes preserve semantic Hot, Warm, and Nurture signals without using them as decorative accents.
The 390px verification covers fixed bottom navigation, safe-area padding, long bucket labels, and odd list counts.
Blocked localStorage still leaves the current theme usable because the existing try/catch behavior was preserved.
